ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the initial state, `Idle`. Its transition is delayed, so nothing else can happen in this tick.
`start` is true, so `Idle` → `Programme` fires. Entering `Programme` enters its initial state, `Filling`, in the same tick: two states are active now, `Programme` and `Filling` inside it.
`Filling` waits for `full`, which is false, so nothing fires. The chart stays in `Programme`, in `Filling`.
`full` is true: `Filling` → `Washing` fires inside `Programme` and switches the motor on. `Programme` stays active: moving between its inner states does not leave it.
Nothing is enabled. The machine keeps washing, and `motor` keeps its value.
`timeUp` is true: `Washing` → `Draining` fires and switches the motor off.
`Draining` has no outgoing transition, so the machine stays here for ever. The rest of the chapter gives it ways out.
